Test for the Difference of Two ROC Curves

Source: R/roc.R
rocTest.Rd

Compares the areas under two ROC curves (or their partial areas, sensitivities or specificities), with roc.test. The curves can be given as "roc" objects or as anything roc() accepts without a reference: a fitted binary "FitMod" model or a cross-validation from crossVal().

Usage

rocTest(roc1, roc2, ...)

Arguments

roc1, roc2

the two ROC curves: objects of class "roc" (from roc() or roc), binary "FitMod" models or "CrossVal" objects, which are passed to roc() first.

...

further arguments passed to roc.test, e.g. method ("delong", "bootstrap", "venkatraman", ...), alternative and paired.

Value

An object of class "htest" as returned by roc.test, with statistic, p.value, estimate and further components.

Details

Whether the curves are paired is decided by pROC from the data: paired if both rest on the same observations with the same response, as for two models fitted to, or cross-validated on, the same sample; unpaired otherwise, e.g. for a development and an external validation sample. The default DeLong test is available in both cases; set paired explicitly where the automatic decision is not wanted.

Two cross-validated curves are paired only if they cover the same observations; a fold that failed in one of them breaks the pairing.

The name follows the naming rules of the package suite; the function is a thin wrapper, all statistics come from pROC.

References

DeLong, E. R., DeLong, D. M. and Clarke-Pearson, D. L. (1988) Comparing the areas under two or more correlated receiver operating characteristic curves: a nonparametric approach. Biometrics, 44(3), 837–845.

Robin, X. et al. (2011) pROC: an open-source package for R and S+ to analyze and compare ROC curves. BMC Bioinformatics, 12, 77.

See also

roc(), roc.test, crossVal()

Other roc: bestCut(), lift(), roc()

Examples

idx <- seq(1, nrow(Admit), by = 2)
dev <- Admit[idx, ]
ext <- Admit[-idx, ]

fit <- fitMod(admit ~ gre + gpa + rank, dev, engine = "logit")

# development against external validation: unpaired DeLong test
rDev <- roc(fit)
#> Error in roc.default(fit): No valid data provided.
rExt <- roc(predict(fit, newdata = ext)[, 2], ref = ext$admit)
#> Error in roc.default(predict(fit, newdata = ext)[, 2], ref = ext$admit): No valid data provided.
rocTest(rDev, rExt)
#> Error: object 'rDev' not found

# two models, cross-validated on the same sample: paired DeLong test
set.seed(1)
cvFull <- crossVal(fitMod(admit ~ gre + gpa + rank, Admit,
                          engine = "logit"))
set.seed(1)
cvSmall <- crossVal(fitMod(admit ~ gpa, Admit, engine = "logit"))
rocTest(cvFull, cvSmall)
#> 
#> 	DeLong's test for two correlated ROC curves
#> 
#> data:  cvFull and cvSmall
#> Z = 1.8766, p-value = 0.06057
#> alternative hypothesis: true difference in AUC is not equal to 0
#> 95 percent confidence interval:
#>  -0.002459669  0.113243898
#> sample estimates:
#> AUC of roc1 AUC of roc2 
#>   0.6663350   0.6109429 
#>
